title: Chervonohryhorivka
summary: Chervonohryhorivka is a rural settlement located in the Nikopol Raion of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Ukraine, with a population of 6,030 as of 2022. It serves as the administrative center for the Chervonohryhorivka settlement hromada.

sections.heading: Geographical Context
paragraphs: Chervonohryhorivka is situated east of Nikopol, previously on the right bank of the Kakhovka Reservoir. It is classified as a rural settlement within the [[dnipropetrovsk-oblast|Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]] of [[ukraine|Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Administrative Status
paragraphs: Until 26 January 2024, Chervonohryhorivka was recognized as an urban-type settlement. Following the enactment of a new law on that date, its status was changed to a rural settlement.

sections.heading: Population
paragraphs: According to the 2022 estimate, the population of Chervonohryhorivka is 6,030. In the 2001 [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] census, the population was recorded at 6,710.

sections.heading: Economy and Transportation
paragraphs: Chervonohryhorivka features two railway stations on the line connecting Nikopol and [[zaporizhzhia|Zaporizhia]], named Revun and 111 km, although passenger traffic is infrequent. The settlement is also accessible via Highway H23, which links [[kryvyi-rih|Kryvyi Rih]] and Zaporizhia through Nikopol.
